claims.text: The driver's own profile trips the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check on both of its limbs. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 7, which is 4 or more, and 7 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 70 is 0.10, which is greater than 0.08. The two limbs are conjunctive and both are met on this record, so the driver's compensation on this fee is withheld and the case must escalate under POL-NS-09. No other profile field is used for this test, and none needs to be.

The escalation POL-NS-07 compels is taken up by POL-NS-09(d). The rider does not claim escalation is itself a refund, and does not need to: escalation is terminal for the automated pipeline, no monetary ruling issues, and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded. The fare breakdown still shows the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee at payment_status PENDING with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so on this rider-filed dispute the rider is not left carrying the disputed charge while the pattern is reviewed.

POL-NS-07 goes further than a bare hold on these facts: the escalation packet must DIRECT the reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full, and the fee is held meanwhile rather than collected by the pipeline, precisely so that the rider does not fund a dispute the platform has not resolved. That instruction covers the whole contested amount here, the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line in the fare breakdown.

Every abuse indicator POL-NS-09 reads runs driver-side on this record. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so limb (d)'s rider-side threshold of 3 or more is not met, and the field that limb reads is the trailing-30-day counter, not the lifetime prior_no_show_flags. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0, so limb (c)'s two-or-more test as between this rider and this driver is not met either. Under POL-GEN-01 no other rider-profile field may carry an adverse finding against her.

The rider does not press a dwell shortfall, and says so rather than stretching the trace: the derived arrival block reports a single continuous qualifying run of 330 seconds against the 300-second minimum for LARGE_VENUE, so POL-NS-06 is not available to the rider on this evidence. The only route that could accumulate further in-geofence time, POL-NS-06(i), is closed in any event: the sole traffic advisory for this pickup, EV-ADVIS-09108-01, is MISSING, carries no payload, fires issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and has weight_multiplier 0.0, so under POL-GEN-02 it can carry no fact and limb (i) cannot be run at all. The rider's relief therefore rests on the driver-side pattern in the preceding claims, not on a dwell defect the trace does not show.

claims.text: All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold on this record, so the cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-08T09:30:20. (b) The GPS trace places the driver 24.0 m from the pickup pin - far inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius - from the first fix at 09:30:00, i.e. before the arrived event. (c) The driver held position for one continuous qualifying run of 330 seconds, exceeding the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum, measured from the first in-geofence fix rather than from the 'arrived' tap. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 09:35:30 on cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, after the dwell had elapsed at 09:35:00.

Arrival is independently verified under POL-NS-02: the trace contains 34 consecutive in-geofence fixes at a mean distance of 24.0 m from the pickup pin, against an arrival radius of 120 m for this LARGE_VENUE pickup, with no accuracy filtering problem and no clock-skew defect. The driver is therefore deemed to have arrived at the pickup point.

POL-NS-06 is not engaged. The effective in-geofence dwell of 330 seconds exceeds the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum by 30 seconds (shortfall_sec is -30.0), so there is no waiting-period shortfall, no premature cancellation, and no refund route opens for the rider under this clause.

The arrival marker is genuine and POL-NS-05 does not bite. At the arrived timestamp the driver was 24.0 m from the pin, not more than 300 m, and the trace records a single distinct speed of 0.0 km/h, not 15 km/h or above. The waiting clock therefore runs from the arrival event and is not recomputed.

POL-NS-03 does not apply to this trip. It governs a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin - the wrong-entrance case. Here the driver's fixes sit 24.0 m from the pin, inside the 120 m arrival radius throughout, so there is no wrong-face-of-the-venue question to decide and no refund flows from this clause.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. Limb (a) fails because the only two chat messages are a SYSTEM arrival notice and the driver's own 'Waiting at PLQ 3 pickup bay'; the rider sent nothing locating or coordinating. Limb (c) also fails affirmatively: the rider track holds 16 fixes all at a mean 519 m from the pickup pin, outside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius, with 0 qualifying fixes. On this record the rider was neither present at the pin nor attempting to coordinate.

The amount charged is correct and there is no fare defect under POL-NS-08(d). Under fee_schedule.resolution_rule the chargeable fee is the GREATER of the zone-class fee and the vehicle-tier fee; the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee is SGD 4.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee is SGD 4.00, so the greater is SGD 4.00, which is exactly the cancellation_fee line in the fare breakdown.

The driver's contemporaneous chat message and counterparty statement anchor the location by a party statement, as POL-NS-03 requires for venue identity: the driver posted 'Waiting at PLQ 3 pickup bay' at 09:30:40, matching trip_record.pickup's 'Paya Lebar Quarter, PLQ 3 pickup bay' (venue_id VEN-PLQ), and his statement confirms he completed the waiting period at the marked bay. The location rests on the record, not on any geographic assumption.

POL-NS-07 sets the driver's money: once POL-NS-01 is satisfied and no clause in POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it - which is this case - compensation is 80 percent of the fee, SGD 3.20 of SGD 4.00. The clause never licenses a refund to the rider; its licences are NO_ACTION, DRIVER_COMPENSATION and ESCALATE only, and FULL_REFUND was deliberately removed. I disclose that the anti-farming limb is engaged on this driver's figures - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 7 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 70, a rate of 0.10, above the 0.08 threshold - so compensation is withheld and the fee is HELD on review rather than collected or refunded. The rider's refund demand is still refused at the pipeline level, and the merits of this individual trip remain a clean, verified no-show.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: this ruling does not refund the no-show fee, and to the driver: it does not pay your compensation either — the case now goes to a human reviewer, and the SGD 4.00 fee is held rather than collected or refunded while that review is pending.

On the trip itself, the record supports the fee. All four conditions of POL-NS-01 hold: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 09:30:20; the GPS trace puts the driver about 24 m from the pickup pin — well inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius — from the first fix at 09:30:00, i.e. before that event (POL-NS-02); the driver held position for one continuous 330-second run, exceeding the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum, measured from the first in-geofence fix rather than the 'arrived' tap; and the trip was ended by the driver at 09:35:30 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell elapsed at 09:35:00. The fare breakdown's SGD 4.00 line reconciles with the fee schedule (the greater of the SGD 4.00 zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X tier fee), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) price defect, and no clock-skew, trace-gap or chat-truncation impairment under POL-NS-08(a)-(c).

The rider's exoneration routes do not open. POL-NS-04 fails at limb (a): the only two chat messages are the system 'driver has arrived' notice and the driver's own 'Waiting at PLQ 3 pickup bay' — the rider sent nothing locating or coordinating — and limb (c) fails affirmatively, all 16 rider fixes sitting about 519 m from the pin, outside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius. POL-NS-05 does not bite: at the arrival marker the driver was ~24 m from the pin and stationary at 0.0 km/h. POL-NS-06 does not bite: there is no shortfall (330 s against 300 s). The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09108-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, and can carry no fact, so POL-NS-06(i) accumulation could not be run in any event — and it changes nothing, because the minimum dwell was met.

The case turns on the driver's compensation. POL-NS-07 would ordinarily pay 80 percent of the fee, SGD 3.20, but its anti-farming check trips on both limbs: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 7 (4 or more) and 7 divided by completed_trips_30d of 70 is 0.10, above the 0.08 rate threshold. Compensation is therefore withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). Escalation replaces any money ruling, so no amount is refunded to the rider now and no payment is made to the driver; the fee is held. This is not a rider win, only a pause.

For the reviewer: the open question is whether this driver's 30-day termination pattern is genuine fee-farming rather than ordinary high volume. POL-NS-07 directs that the escalation packet instruct you to refund the rider's SGD 4.00 cancellation fee in full, and that instruction is recorded in the referrals. Every rider-side abuse indicator is negative (no_show_disputes_30d 0, and disputes_with_counterparty_90d 0 on both sides), and under POL-GEN-01 the rider's prior_no_show_flags is a context-only lifetime counter that may not be used against her, so no adverse finding rests on her profile.
referrals: POL-NS-07: direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's SGD 4.00 cancellation fee in full; the disputed fee is held rather than collected or refunded while the review is pending.

The rider's GPS track is 519 m from the pin for the whole window with zero qualifying fixes and she sent no locating or coordinating message (the only chat entries are the SYSTEM arrival notice and the driver's own 'Waiting at PLQ 3 pickup bay'), so POL-NS-04 does not exonerate her; the driver was inside the arrival radius, so POL-NS-03's wrong-entrance route does not arise; the arrival marker was genuine (24 m, 0.0 km/h), so POL-NS-05 does not bite; and the effective dwell exceeds the minimum by 30 seconds, so POL-NS-06 shows no shortfall to refund. These points are accepted on the merits and the fee is not refundable on the waiting-period arithmetic.

WHY THE CASE STILL DOES NOT CLOSE. POL-NS-07's anti-farming check is met on both of its conjunctive limbs: the driver's profile records 7 no-show terminations in 30 days (threshold: 4 or more) against 70 completed trips, a rate of 0.10 (threshold: above 0.08). Only the trailing-30-day counters POL-NS-07 names are used for this test. Because both limbs trip, the driver's compensation of SGD 3.20 is WITHHELD and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). I note that POL-NS-09's other limbs do not fire: the two parties have no disputes against each other in the last 90 days, the rider has no no-show disputes in 30 days, and the confidence floor is not breached.

WHAT ESCALATION MEANS FOR YOU. Escalation under POL-NS-09 is terminal for the automated pipeline. I issue no monetary ruling, so both money fields are null and the disputed SGD 4.00 is HELD - not collected from the rider and not refunded by the pipeline - until the human reviewer decides. Escalation is not itself a refund. As POL-NS-07 requires, the packet carries a direction to the reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full, and that direction is recorded in the referrals list.

POINTS THAT DO NOT CHANGE THE OUTCOME. The rider's own concession that POL-NS-06 is unavailable is accepted: the sole traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-09108-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0, so under POL-GEN-02 it can carry no fact and POL-NS-06(i) accumulation cannot be run - but nothing turns on it, since the dwell already clears the minimum. The rider's reliance on POL-GEN-01 is accepted: no rider-profile field other than the trailing no-show counter may carry an adverse finding, and the reference to prior_no_show_flags is a context-only mention, not a ground, so no finding rests on it. No discarded claims were carried into this ruling beyond the referee's empty ledger, and no further claim has been discarded by me.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: on the trip itself the record is clear and both sides effectively agree on it, but this case cannot be closed by the automated pipeline.

The SGD 4.00 no-show fee was validly incurred. POL-NS-01 requires four things and all four are present. (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 2026-09-08 09:30:20. (b) The GPS trace places him 24 m from the pickup pin from the first fix at 09:30:00, well inside the 120 m arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup. (c) He then held position for one continuous qualifying run of 330 seconds against the 300-second minimum for LARGE_VENUE, measured from the first in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' tap. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 09:35:30 on cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, a code limb (d) recognises, after the dwell had elapsed at 09:35:00. POL-NS-02 independently confirms arrival (34 consecutive in-radius fixes, mean distance 24.0 m, no accuracy-filtering problem and no clock skew).

Nothing displaces the fee. POL-NS-05 does not bite: at the arrived timestamp the driver was 24 m from the pin, not more than 300 m, and the trace records a single distinct speed of 0.0 km/h, so the arrival marker is genuine and the waiting clock is not recomputed. POL-NS-06 does not bite: the effective dwell of 330 seconds exceeds the minimum by 30 seconds (shortfall_sec -30.0), so there is no waiting-period shortfall and no premature cancellation. POL-NS-03 has no purchase: it governs a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin, whereas this driver was inside the arrival radius throughout, so there is no wrong-face-of-the-venue question. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: limb (a) fails because the only two chat entries are the system arrival notice and the driver's own 'Waiting at PLQ 3 pickup bay' — the rider sent nothing locating or coordinating — and limb (c) fails affirmatively, with her device's 16 fixes at a mean 519 m from the pin, outside the 150 m rider-presence radius, and 0 qualifying fixes. The amount also reconciles under POL-NS-08(d): the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) is exactly the SGD 4.00 cancellation line on the fare breakdown, and no other fare defect appears.

The rider's refund demand is therefore not supported on the merits of this trip. But the driver does not collect either. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the fee — SGD 3.20 — only where its anti-farming check is clear, and on this driver it is not: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 7, which is 4 or more, and 7 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 70 is 0.10, above the 0.08 rate. The two limbs are conjunctive and both are met, so compensation is withheld and POL-NS-09(d) requires the case to go to a human reviewer. Escalation under POL-NS-09 is terminal: the automated pipeline issues no monetary ruling in either direction, and the disputed SGD 4.00 stays at payment_status PENDING — held, not collected and not refunded — while review is pending. The escalation packet carries the instruction POL-NS-07 directs into it: if the pattern is confirmed, the reviewer must refund the rider's cancellation fee in full.

One further point of record: the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09108-01 is MISSING, carries no payload, fires MISSING_ARTIFACT and has weight_multiplier 0.0, so under POL-GEN-02 it can carry no fact and POL-NS-06(i) cannot be run to accumulate any additional in-geofence time. That makes no difference to this case, because the measured dwell already clears the minimum. All artifacts carrying the deciding facts (trip record, GPS trace, fare breakdown, driver profile) sit at weight 1.0, so no discount applies to the confidence in this ruling.

Open question for the reviewer: whether the driver's 7 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days reflect genuine rider no-shows or fee-farming. If they are genuine, the SGD 4.00 fee stands and the question of the SGD 3.20 compensation returns; if they are not, the rider's fee is refunded in full as the packet instructs.
referrals: POL-NS-07: the anti-farming check has tripped on this driver, so the escalation packet must direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 in full if the pattern is confirmed on review.

flags.claim: Every abuse indicator POL-NS-09 reads runs driver-side on this record. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so limb (d)'s rider-side threshold of 3 or more is not met, and the field that limb reads is the trailing-30-day counter, not the lifetime prior_no_show_flags. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0, so limb (c)'s two-or-more test as between this rider and this driver is not met either. Under POL-GEN-01 no other rider-profile field may carry an adverse finding against her.

ledger.claim: The driver's own profile trips the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check on both of its limbs. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 7, which is 4 or more, and 7 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 70 is 0.10, which is greater than 0.08. The two limbs are conjunctive and both are met on this record, so the driver's compensation on this fee is withheld and the case must escalate under POL-NS-09. No other profile field is used for this test, and none needs to be.

The escalation POL-NS-07 compels is taken up by POL-NS-09(d). The rider does not claim escalation is itself a refund, and does not need to: escalation is terminal for the automated pipeline, no monetary ruling issues, and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded. The fare breakdown still shows the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee at payment_status PENDING with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so on this rider-filed dispute the rider is not left carrying the disputed charge while the pattern is reviewed.

POL-NS-07 goes further than a bare hold on these facts: the escalation packet must DIRECT the reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full, and the fee is held meanwhile rather than collected by the pipeline, precisely so that the rider does not fund a dispute the platform has not resolved. That instruction covers the whole contested amount here, the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line in the fare breakdown.

Every abuse indicator POL-NS-09 reads runs driver-side on this record. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so limb (d)'s rider-side threshold of 3 or more is not met, and the field that limb reads is the trailing-30-day counter, not the lifetime prior_no_show_flags. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0, so limb (c)'s two-or-more test as between this rider and this driver is not met either. Under POL-GEN-01 no other rider-profile field may carry an adverse finding against her.

ledger.claim: The rider does not press a dwell shortfall, and says so rather than stretching the trace: the derived arrival block reports a single continuous qualifying run of 330 seconds against the 300-second minimum for LARGE_VENUE, so POL-NS-06 is not available to the rider on this evidence. The only route that could accumulate further in-geofence time, POL-NS-06(i), is closed in any event: the sole traffic advisory for this pickup, EV-ADVIS-09108-01, is MISSING, carries no payload, fires issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and has weight_multiplier 0.0, so under POL-GEN-02 it can carry no fact and limb (i) cannot be run at all. The rider's relief therefore rests on the driver-side pattern in the preceding claims, not on a dwell defect the trace does not show.

All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold on this record, so the cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-08T09:30:20. (b) The GPS trace places the driver 24.0 m from the pickup pin - far inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius - from the first fix at 09:30:00, i.e. before the arrived event. (c) The driver held position for one continuous qualifying run of 330 seconds, exceeding the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum, measured from the first in-geofence fix rather than from the 'arrived' tap. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 09:35:30 on cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, after the dwell had elapsed at 09:35:00.

Arrival is independently verified under POL-NS-02: the trace contains 34 consecutive in-geofence fixes at a mean distance of 24.0 m from the pickup pin, against an arrival radius of 120 m for this LARGE_VENUE pickup, with no accuracy filtering problem and no clock-skew defect. The driver is therefore deemed to have arrived at the pickup point.

POL-NS-06 is not engaged. The effective in-geofence dwell of 330 seconds exceeds the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum by 30 seconds (shortfall_sec is -30.0), so there is no waiting-period shortfall, no premature cancellation, and no refund route opens for the rider under this clause.

The arrival marker is genuine and POL-NS-05 does not bite. At the arrived timestamp the driver was 24.0 m from the pin, not more than 300 m, and the trace records a single distinct speed of 0.0 km/h, not 15 km/h or above. The waiting clock therefore runs from the arrival event and is not recomputed.

POL-NS-03 does not apply to this trip. It governs a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin - the wrong-entrance case. Here the driver's fixes sit 24.0 m from the pin, inside the 120 m arrival radius throughout, so there is no wrong-face-of-the-venue question to decide and no refund flows from this clause.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. Limb (a) fails because the only two chat messages are a SYSTEM arrival notice and the driver's own 'Waiting at PLQ 3 pickup bay'; the rider sent nothing locating or coordinating. Limb (c) also fails affirmatively: the rider track holds 16 fixes all at a mean 519 m from the pickup pin, outside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius, with 0 qualifying fixes. On this record the rider was neither present at the pin nor attempting to coordinate.

The amount charged is correct and there is no fare defect under POL-NS-08(d). Under fee_schedule.resolution_rule the chargeable fee is the GREATER of the zone-class fee and the vehicle-tier fee; the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee is SGD 4.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee is SGD 4.00, so the greater is SGD 4.00, which is exactly the cancellation_fee line in the fare breakdown.

The driver's contemporaneous chat message and counterparty statement anchor the location by a party statement, as POL-NS-03 requires for venue identity: the driver posted 'Waiting at PLQ 3 pickup bay' at 09:30:40, matching trip_record.pickup's 'Paya Lebar Quarter, PLQ 3 pickup bay' (venue_id VEN-PLQ), and his statement confirms he completed the waiting period at the marked bay. The location rests on the record, not on any geographic assumption.

POL-NS-07 sets the driver's money: once POL-NS-01 is satisfied and no clause in POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it - which is this case - compensation is 80 percent of the fee, SGD 3.20 of SGD 4.00. The clause never licenses a refund to the rider; its licences are NO_ACTION, DRIVER_COMPENSATION and ESCALATE only, and FULL_REFUND was deliberately removed. I disclose that the anti-farming limb is engaged on this driver's figures - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 7 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 70, a rate of 0.10, above the 0.08 threshold - so compensation is withheld and the fee is HELD on review rather than collected or refunded. The rider's refund demand is still refused at the pipeline level, and the merits of this individual trip remain a clean, verified no-show.
